1. Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.

3. The petitioner seeks grant of regular bail in FIR No. 791/2018 registered at Police Station Narela for the offences punishable under Sections 323/365/376-D/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

sentences.text: Accordingly, let intimation be sent by the Investigating Officer to the complainant/victim informing them that they are entitled to be heard in the present proceedings, for which they may remain present (either in-person or via video-conferencing) or be represented on the next date.
